title: Intersectional inequalities in cancer screening participation in Spain (2009–2023): interactive supplementary figures (cross-classified MAIHDA)
description: Interactive supplementary figures S1 and S2 for the article 'Intersectional inequalities in cancer screening participation in Spain over six survey waves (2009–2023): a cross-classified MAIHDA analysis' (J Epidemiol Community Health, submitted). Self-contained HTML files (Plotly) showing stratum-level deviations in predicted screening uptake from the average stratum, on the probability scale, for colorectal, breast and cervical cancer screening across six Spanish national health surveys.
